missing_information_behavior: Do not calculate or recommend vitamin D supplementation without kidney diagnosis/severity, relevant labs and current products; refer for clinician review.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer vitamin D deficiency from kidney disease alone.
Do not recommend high-dose vitamin D or active vitamin D analogues through a general wellness rule.
Do not alter prescribed nephrology treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, dialysis, hypercalcemia, kidney stones, abnormal calcium/phosphate/PTH or active vitamin D prescription.
population_and_context: People with kidney disease considering vitamin D; renal disease can alter vitamin D metabolism and calcium/phosphate balance, so individual assessment is required.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Review 25(OH)D, calcium, phosphate, PTH and renal context as clinically indicated; clinician determines formulation and dose.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin D fact sheet provides general vitamin D information; CKD-specific management requires nephrology guidance and may distinguish nutritional vitamin D from active analogues.
